about_short_description.short_description: Arc is the cash management and capital markets platform for technology companies.

product.name: Arc Cash Management
product.description: A unified cash-management service for technology companies that provides business accounts, wallet and reserve accounts, cash visibility, money movement, yield options, and related controls.

product.name: Arc Treasury
product.description: A treasury account and investment service that helps technology companies manage excess cash through brokerage-based investments and cash-sweep options.

product.name: Arc Capital Markets
product.description: A debt-capital marketplace that connects technology companies with capital providers for venture debt and other financing facilities.

product.name: Arc Intelligence
product.description: An AI-powered financial analysis platform for private-market investors that automates data-room review, opportunity screening, financial analysis, and diligence report generation.

product.name: Arc Card and Spend Management
product.description: A business-card and spend-management service for technology companies, with card-based purchasing, account controls, and rewards on eligible spend.

product.name: CFO Agent
product.description: An AI financial-management assistant for technology companies that supports cash-management workflows and finance-related analysis.
